paper.authors: Xinglong Ju and Feng Liu and Li Wang and Wei-Jen Lee
paper.title: Wind farm layout optimization based on support vector regression guided genetic algorithm with consideration of participation among landowners

same_lineage_public_assets.role: paper-linked author SUGGA, masks, wake, SVR and experiment source
official native C++ backend of the source's sklearn.svm.SVR

paper_source_conflicts: Paper cell width 154 m conflicts with public-source 231 m.
Paper hub height 88 m conflicts with public-source class value 80 m.
Paper probability rates conflict with source standard-normal threshold comparisons.
Paper declares crossover rate and elite retention while source ignores the 0.6 rate and fills the entire next population by crossover.
Paper independent repeats conflict with source operator-level integer-wall-time reseeding.
missing_information: author initial populations and Monte-Carlo layouts
author random states and tie behavior
complete paper-only crossover filling and elite lifecycle
completion_decisions: Use paper-primary 154 m cells, 88 m hub and ordinary probability events.
Preserve a separately executable source-normal-threshold identity with 231 m cells and 80 m hub.
Use the complete public-source all-offspring lifecycle where paper-only details are insufficient.
Regenerate uniform fixed-cardinality layouts with counter-keyed random events.
Train official LIBSVM epsilon-SVR from scratch for every paper problem.
Implement only SUGGA as the target contribution; CGA and AGA remain excluded paper baselines.
Precompute direction-node-node wake deficits and parallelize truth layouts and individual updates.

decision_variables.resolution: fixed-cardinality subset of the 144 grid cells, with N=15,20,25

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: sorted occupied-cell set equivalent to the source binary chromosome and nonzero-index cache

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize expected power and report conversion efficiency

constraints_and_repair.resolution: one turbine per available cell; exact L0-L12 landowner masks; cardinality-preserving relocation/crossover/mutation

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: Jensen overlap wake, squared-deficit superposition and GE-1.5sle power curve

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: D1, D2 and D3 tabulated discrete 13 m/s wind profiles

initialization.resolution: uniform unique fixed-cardinality layouts over available cells

update_order.resolution: evaluate, rank, retain external best, relocate worst, select, all-offspring crossover, mutate

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: one 10000-layout training artifact per problem plus 120 complete population evaluations for 200 generations per repeat

parameters.resolution: paper physical values; source population 120, rates 0.2/0.6/0.5/0.1, five guided candidates; SVR C=2000 gamma=0.3 epsilon=0.1

training_and_inference_lifecycle.resolution: train one official LIBSVM RBF epsilon-SVR from 10000 truth layouts per problem and reuse across 100 runs

paper_native_cases.resolution: 3 wind profiles x 13 landscapes x 3 turbine counts = 117 problems

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: 100 repeats per problem, conversion efficiency, convergence, timings, FES, worker receipt and scientific hash

scope.claim_boundary: academic paper/source flexible reproduction of SUGGA and all 117 native problems; not author numerical, trained-model or random-bitstream replay
